title: 永遠 EIEN
description: A Create-focused modpack built for the 永遠 EIEN multiplayer server.
body:
**永遠 EIEN is Eternity.** This modpack is a customized collection of mods focused around [Create](https://modrinth.com/mod/create), with custom quests explaining the mod's progression. There is also an emphasis on exploration, with aesthetic and exciting world-generation using [Terralith](https://modrinth.com/mod/terralith) and [Continents](https://modrinth.com/mod/continents). This landscape works great for connecting the world via train or airship. Many recipes have been customized to rely on Create methods, or to fit in better to the modpack's progression system. A number of optimization mods are also added in order to try and make it playable on less-powerful computers.

This modpack is designed to be used as part of a private, multiplayer server.

---

> ⚠️ The modpack does support some external mods that need to be downloaded _individually_ in order to get the full modpack experience. However, **these are not required**. These mods are FTB Backups, FTB Filters, FTB Library, FTB Quests, FTB Teams, and FTB XMod Compat. These mods serve as the backbone for the custom quest system. They can be found easily on CurseForge. Please contact me if you have any questions or concerns. I am on Discord as `oceanartemis`.

---

Gallery images made using [Miniature](https://modrinth.com/shader/miniature-shader) and [Complementary](https://modrinth.com/shader/complementary-reimagined) shaders.
